content.title: Your horoscope for the full pink moon in Libra is calling you to release what you've outgrown
content.text: Full Moons are a time for releasing and relinquishing. If you have an excess in your life—emotional clutter, overcommitments, toxic attachments—this is the cosmic cue to drain it out. Whether through silent meditation, honest conversations, or grounding spiritual rituals, Full Moons offer us a ritual checkpoint to let go. April’s Full Moon in Libra marks a key turning point, astrologically hinting that it’s time to take control of your own evolution. Following Western astrology, these new and full Moon guides are monthly reminders to reset, reflect, and recommit to your path. Your horoscope is less of a prediction and more of a sacred prompt for self-inquiry.Happy Full Moon in Libra, my CyberStars! On Thursday 2 April at 3:12am BST the Moon reaches fullness in Libra. This full moon is also called the “Pink Moon,” a name that originally came from Indigenous Americans, specifically the Algonquin Tribe, because it occurs at the beginning of spring. Think blooming wildflowers, renewal, and most importantly, fresh starts (so, no, the moon likely won’t be literally pink).This Full Moon in Libra will be directly opposing the Sun in Aries. This brings your attention to the balance between independence and partnership—where “me” meets “we.” And while that may sound simple, this Full Moon is here to show you where that balance has quietly tipped. Where have you been maintaining connection at the expense of yourself? Or choosing yourself in ways that avoid the vulnerability of true connection?With the Moon in Libra, emotions naturally orient toward Venusian themes: love, aesthetics, money, and desirability. There’s a pull to smooth things over, to look good, to feel good, to keep things pleasant. But Full Moons don’t prioritise comfort—they prioritise clarity. And clarity often asks you to release what you’ve been trying to make work long past its natural expiration date.So before you start adding to cart, pause. This isn’t about getting more—it’s about needing less. That foundation that irritates your skin. The dress that belongs to a version of you you’ve already outgrown. The emotional attachment to something (or someone) that no longer aligns with who you’re becoming. Yes, even that situationship t-shirt. Let it go. Donate it, delete it, release it.Everyone's clicking on...This Full Moon is about choosing yourself without fear. Not from isolation, not from avoidance—but from alignment. Not everything is meant to come with you—and that’s exactly what makes space for what’s next.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowA helpful tool here is cognitive defusion. Instead of saying, “I’ll regret letting this go,” try “I’m having the thought that I’ll regret this.” That small shift creates distance, allowing you to act from clarity, not fear. Because this Full Moon isn’t asking you to lose something valuable. It’s asking you to release what you’ve outgrown.Energetic OverviewFull Moon in Libra opposite Sun in Aries: self vs. relationshipThis lunation exposes imbalance. Where have you over-accommodated others—or over-prioritised yourself? The goal is not choosing one, but integrating both.Libra Moon (Venus-ruled): emotional filtering through connectionThere’s a desire to maintain harmony, even if something has run its course. Be mindful of trying to “balance” what actually needs to be released.Jupiter square Sun + Moon: emotional and mental exaggerationYou may feel conflicted between what’s familiar and what’s right. Expansion here requires letting go—even when it feels uncertain.Aries–Libra axis: individuation vs. attachmentThis is about differentiation—maintaining your identity within connection, not losing yourself to preserve it.Read your horoscope based on your Sun, Moon, and Rising signs for the Full Moon in Libra happening on 2 April at 3:12am BSTRead your Sun sign to gain insight into the version of yourself that you're maturing into. Read your Rising sign to reflect on your present state. And read your Moon sign for guidance on how to grow your inner child (no one is perfect). If you find your horoscope helpful, please share it and tag me on social media @monishaholmes.Jump to:AriesTaurusGeminiCancerLeoVirgoLibraScorpioSagittariusCapricornAquariusPiscesAriesThis Full Moon pulls your attention toward your relationships, illuminating where independence and connection are out of balance. You may notice moments where you’ve been overly accommodating to maintain harmony, or pulling away to preserve control. Libra energy seeks mutuality, but not at the cost of self-abandonment. With Saturn in your sign, you’re being asked to define yourself through action—without over-explaining or adjusting to be better received. At the same time, Jupiter’s square may heighten emotional responses, making it harder to distinguish discomfort from misalignment. Not every uneasy feeling means something is wrong—sometimes it signals growth. This is a moment to observe how you show up in connection. Are you choosing relationships that allow you to remain yourself, or ones that require constant negotiation?Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowMoon lesson: Balance does not require self-sacrifice.TaurusThis Full Moon highlights your routines, habits, and daily structure—revealing what’s supporting you versus what’s quietly draining you. Libra energy wants your life to feel balanced and aesthetically aligned, but Aries reminds you that your energy is limited. You may feel the urge to reset or reorganise, but this isn’t about perfection. It’s about alignment. With Jupiter’s influence, you might be tempted to overcommit or justify keeping habits that feel familiar. However, familiarity is not the same as sustainability. Saturn in Aries asks you to take responsibility for your energy. Where are you saying yes out of habit rather than intention? What are you maintaining simply because it’s comfortable?Moon lesson: Your habits should support you, not exhaust you.GeminiThis Full Moon illuminates your relationship with pleasure, creativity, and self-expression. You may become aware of where you’ve been seeking validation rather than creating from authenticity. Libra energy wants to be liked, while Aries energy wants to be real. If you’ve been filtering yourself to maintain approval, this lunation invites you to loosen that grip. With Jupiter’s square, there may be a tendency to overextend your energy socially or creatively in an attempt to feel seen. But recognition that requires self-editing often feels unsatisfying. This is a moment to reconnect with what feels genuinely expressive to you—without considering how it will be received. Not everything needs to be curated.Moon lesson: Authenticity is more magnetic than approval.CancerThis Full Moon activates your home, emotional foundation, and sense of security. You may feel tension between maintaining external harmony and addressing what’s actually going on internally. Libra energy can encourage you to smooth things over, but Aries reminds you that avoidance isn’t resolution. With Jupiter’s influence, emotions may feel amplified, making it tempting to either overextend yourself for others or withdraw entirely. Neither extreme creates stability. Saturn in Aries asks you to take ownership of your emotional boundaries. Where are you prioritising peace over truth? What conversations or adjustments have you been avoiding? Creating a stable foundation now requires honesty—not just with others, but with yourself.Moon lesson: Peace comes from honesty, not avoidance.LeoThis Full Moon brings attention to your communication patterns—how you express yourself and how you interpret others. You may notice where you’ve been over-explaining, softening your truth, or seeking validation through conversation. Libra energy values diplomacy, but Aries energy values directness. This lunation asks you to integrate both. With Jupiter’s square, there may be a tendency to overthink interactions or read too deeply into others’ responses. Not everything requires analysis. Saturn in Aries encourages you to stand in your perspective without needing constant agreement. You don’t have to convince everyone to understand you in order to be valid. Say what you mean—clearly and calmly—without over-editing yourself to maintain comfort.Moon lesson: Clarity is kinder than over-accommodation.VirgoThis Full Moon highlights your relationship with self-worth, finances, and what you value. You may feel tension between holding onto something for security and releasing it for growth. Libra energy asks you to evaluate what feels balanced and fair, while Aries pushes you to act on that awareness. With Jupiter’s square, there may be a tendency to rationalise keeping things “just in case.” However, security built on excess or fear is not true stability. Saturn in Aries asks you to take responsibility for your choices. What are you holding onto out of habit rather than necessity? This is a moment to reassess what actually supports your sense of worth—and what simply feels familiar.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowMoon lesson: Security grows when you trust your decisions.LibraThis Full Moon occurs in your sign, bringing a moment of personal clarity. You may see yourself reflected through your relationships—what you’ve tolerated, where you’ve compromised, and what you truly need. Libra energy often prioritises harmony, but this lunation asks whether that harmony has been authentic. Aries energy reminds you that you are allowed to take up space without negotiating your identity. With Jupiter’s square, there may be emotional intensity or a tendency to second-guess yourself. Not every reaction from others is a reflection of your choices. Saturn in Aries encourages you to define yourself clearly, even if it disrupts existing dynamics.Moon lesson: You don’t need permission to be yourself.ScorpioThis Full Moon activates your inner world, bringing awareness to subconscious patterns and emotional habits. You may notice where you’ve been holding onto something out of fear rather than alignment. Libra energy encourages release through balance, while Aries pushes for direct acknowledgment. With Jupiter’s square, emotions may feel heightened, making it tempting to overanalyse or attach meaning to every feeling. Not everything requires dissection. Saturn in Aries asks you to take responsibility for what you’re carrying. What are you holding onto simply because it feels familiar? This is a moment to release without needing full closure or explanation.Moon lesson: Release doesn’t require full understanding.SagittariusThis Full Moon highlights your social life, friendships, and long-term vision. You may recognise where certain connections feel aligned—and where others feel more like obligation than intention. Libra energy values connection, but Aries reminds you that not every relationship needs to be maintained. With Jupiter’s square, there may be a tendency to overextend yourself socially or hold onto connections out of optimism rather than reality. Saturn in Aries asks you to be more intentional with your energy. Who supports your growth—and who simply occupies space? This is a moment to refine your circle so it reflects where you’re going, not where you’ve been.Moon lesson: Alignment matters more than access.CapricornThis Full Moon brings focus to your career, public image, and long-term direction. You may feel tension between maintaining external expectations and aligning with your personal truth. Libra energy can encourage you to keep things polished and agreeable, while Aries asks you to lead authentically. With Jupiter’s square, there may be pressure to do more, achieve more, or maintain appearances—but expansion without alignment leads to burnout. Saturn in Aries calls for accountability to your own definition of success. Are you pursuing what feels right, or what looks right? This is a moment to recalibrate your direction so it reflects your values, not just external validation.Moon lesson: Integrity is more important than perception.AquariusThis Full Moon expands your perspective, highlighting your beliefs, philosophies, and sense of direction. You may feel called to release outdated ideas or frameworks that no longer resonate. Libra energy seeks balance in perspective, while Aries pushes you to define your own truth. With Jupiter’s square, there may be a tendency to overthink or search for certainty before moving forward. However, growth often requires acting without complete clarity. Saturn in Aries asks you to stand in your perspective—even if it’s still evolving. You don’t need all the answers to move in the right direction. This is a moment to refine what you believe based on experience, not just theory.Moon lesson: Evolving your perspective is a sign of growth.PiscesThis Full Moon brings attention to your emotional bonds, shared resources, and deeper attachments. You may notice where something feels imbalanced or where you’ve been holding on out of comfort rather than alignment. Libra energy seeks fairness in exchange, while Aries encourages independence. With Jupiter’s square, emotions may feel intensified, making it harder to release what feels familiar—even if it’s no longer supportive. Saturn in Aries asks you to take responsibility for your boundaries. Where are you giving more than you’re receiving? This is a moment to release attachments that no longer align with your growth—even if they once felt essential.Moon lesson: Letting go creates space for deeper alignment.
